headline: A Round of Answers
deck: A charity invitation. A familiar rival. Nothing casual about the round.
body: The invitation promised a morning for a good cause. The round exposed less charitable intentions. Dr. Duckhook knew every ridge of his own course; ObiWan Jacoby had returned with a memory the host would rather forget. A clean strike earned a glance. A ball in the rough earned silence. By the time they walked toward the green, the autumn light was still beautiful. Neither rival was looking at it.
